edu.title: How Lexicamp works
edu.s1Body: Lexicamp uses a spaced-repetition model that predicts when you're about to forget a word, and puts the review right there. You study less and remember more.
edu.s2Body: A word becomes due for review when its predicted memory strength drops toward forgetting. Recall it successfully and the next review moves further out; miss it and its reviews return sooner.
edu.s3Title: Getting the most out of it
edu.s3Body: Rate your recall honestly. The schedule is only as good as your feedback. Short daily sessions beat occasional long ones.
edu.dismissA11y: Hide the "How Lexicamp works" card. You can review it anytime from Settings.

onboarding.welcomeSub: Learn smarter with science-backed spaced repetition.
onboarding.s1Title: The problem: Most words slip away within a week
onboarding.s1Body: This is known as the "forgetting curve"¹. Lexicamp leverages this curve by scheduling reviews before you forget.
onboarding.s1Note: ¹ Ebbinghaus, 1885 — replicated by Murre & Dros, 2015.
onboarding.curveCaption: How likely you are to recall a new new word over time
onboarding.s2Body: Lexicamp builds the optimal study deck by excluding words you already know and prioritizing only the words that need review².
onboarding.s2Note: ² Memory strength: how long a word stays recallable before it fades.
onboarding.s3Title: Some words are harder than others
onboarding.s3Body: Lexicamp adapts your review deck to your feedback so that you spend time studying only what you need to (and not what you don't).
onboarding.s4Title: See your memories grow over time
onboarding.s4Body: Lexicamp utilizes the FSRS algorithm³ to accurately track words as they move into long term memory.
onboarding.s4Note: ³ FSRS — the open-source Free Spaced Repetition Scheduler.
onboarding.s5Body: 3000 words is the summit; Lexicamp provides the optimal route to the top.
onboarding.s6Title: The summit is closer than you think
onboarding.s6Body: By saving a few words in Lexicamp, you'll be on your way to foreign language mastery.
onboarding.langSub: Lexicamp uses these to translate and quiz you.
onboarding.nativeNote: More native languages are on the way.
onboarding.langPremiumNote: You can add more languages later with Premium.
onboarding.notifBody: Get scheduled study reminders at the optimal moment your words are ready for review.

walkthrough.w1Body: This card shows what's due and starts your session. It's the only thing you need on a busy day.
walkthrough.w2Body: Tap here whenever you meet a word worth keeping. Saving it schedules it automatically.
walkthrough.w3Body: Type a word to see how it translates, with real examples of how it's used.
walkthrough.w3bBody: Most words carry more than one. Save the one you actually came across, and that's the one you'll practise.
walkthrough.w4Body: Everything you've saved lives here. Search it, filter it, open any word for detail.
walkthrough.w5Body: When words come due, Study now starts the session. Let's step inside one.
walkthrough.w6Body: Try to recall first, then grade yourself honestly. Your rating tells Lexicamp when to bring the word back.
walkthrough.w7Body: After each session you'll see how far each word moved and when it returns, scheduled to land just before you'd forget.
walkthrough.w8Body: Your progress adds up here. The summit is closer than it looks.
